title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description:
Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more about our career opportunities here.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth. You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Network & Connectivity

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless.
  • Maintain and evolve high-availability data center fabrics (e.g., spine-and-leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware).
  • Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers, including WAN and SD-WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.

Wireless, Load Balancing & Security

  • Configure and support wireless networks (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba and Cisco.
  • Operate and tune load balancers (e.g., F5, including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience.
  • Collaborate with security teams on Next-Generation Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security-first” network design.

Automation, IaC & Observability

  • Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible.
  • Implement and maintain network performance monitoring and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar, ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents.
  • Manage PKI-related activities, including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints.

Delivery & Collaboration

  • Lead or co-lead new office implementations and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams.
  • Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences.
  • Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team.
  • Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi-level team (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure.

We Are Looking for a Person Who Has

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering, working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission-critical operations).
  • Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, ideally using vendors such as Cisco and/or Juniper.
  • Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks, especially with Aruba and/or Cisco wireless solutions.
  • Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana or similar) in production environments.
  • Experience with load balancers (e.g., F5) and DNS-related components (e.g., ZoneRunner or equivalent).
  • Exposure to network security components, such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security-first” posture.
  • Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible).
  • Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross-functional, multicultural teams.
  • Intermediate English (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust network concepts and security-driven networking.
  • Experience with cloud networking (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments.
  • Experience with security mindset and encryption topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization.
  • Prior experience in distributed or global organizations.

Location

This opportunity is based in Brazil , with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our offices in:

  • Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
  • Belo Horizonte, Brazil

You will be part of the Brazil Global Offices Network team and collaborate with colleagues in other locations as needed.

title: Neurology Administrative and Research Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

As an integral part of the Department of Neurology, the Administrative and Research Coordinator provides a range of administrative support to the Department Chair and multiple faculty in the Department of Neurology at Howard University. Responsibilities include assisting with daily administrative operations, coordinating and scheduling complex appointments and meetings, coordinating travel and preparing associated materials, preparing correspondence, compiling data, coordinating special projects and events, and records maintenance. This position will be responsible for monitoring departmental academic and research budgets and business affairs, personnel matters and interpreting policy and procedures. The position will perform duties of a sensitive and confidential nature. Incumbents typically work at a high degree of independence with general direction and supervision received from the Department Chair. This position also plays a pivotal role in the administration and execution of research projects, ensuring that studies are conducted efficiently, ethically, and in compliance with regulatory standards. Serving as a liaison among investigators, participants and regulatory bodies, the admin and research coordinator manages daily operations, overseas participant recruitment and data collection, and maintains meticulous documentation to support the integrity and success of research endeavors.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for orienting and training other administrative hires, as needed in the future. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over clerical positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks. May involve supervision of entry level research coordinator(s) or research fellow(s).

Nature And Scope

  • Compose and prepare correspondence as well as assist in writing and preparation of manuscripts, grants, questionnaires, journal reviews, presentations, reports, letters, and memos for the Chair’s review and signature.
  • Read email and coordinate office communications ensuring timeliness and accuracy.
  • Screen and provide telephone coverage for the Chair, Faculty, and administrative offices.
  • Represent the Chair in meetings, take dictation, minutes, notes and prepare final copy for review and arrange department meetings.
  • Create graphic brochures, posters, signs, labels for conferences, newsletters, invitations and presentation slides for the department.
  • Assist the Chair with activities relating to the University/College of Medicine, the Faculty Practice Plan (FPP), and the Hospital (HUH).
  • Assist the Chair in the preparation of all faculty appointment, promotion and tenure applications and performance evaluations (e.g., OPPE).
  • Assist with departmental development/philanthropic projects and continuing medical education (CME) conferences.
  • Internal contacts include students, faculty and staff. External contacts include study sponsors, clinical trials staff, patients, parents, hospital officials, local health departments, community providers and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist and submit Attending Physicians OPPE and FPPE
  • Coordinate Attending Physicians and staff work requests for facility maintenance or housekeeping
  • Coordinate CME activities and other events
  • Coordinate Department Events, on and off‑campus
  • Prepare annual and operational reports for the Chair’s approval
  • Prepare and compile department appointment/re‑appointment/promotion/tenure documents
  • Order regalia for Honors & Oath (medical school graduation) ceremony
  • Order plaque and submit check request for neurology prize recipient
  • Assist faculty with grant applications
  • Prepare and submit expense vouchers, arrange travel schedules
  • Submit Attending Physicians leave slips
  • Submit Attending Physician Clinic schedule changes
  • Prepare and assist with the development of department budget and proposals
  • Prepare and submit external and internal letters, memos and/or forms for Attending Physicians
  • Facilitate Attending Physicians and staff computer, printer issues
  • Maintain Attending Physicians on‑call schedule
  • Order Neurology office supplies / furniture
  • Manage vendor relationships and contracts for hardware, software, equipment and services
  • Coordination of purchase and maintenance of departmental equipment and licensing agreements
  • Manage overall department appearance: painting, seasonal decorations
  • Coordinate departmental fundraiser(s) and annual alumni donation campaign
  • Maintain accurate alumni contact list
  • Coordinate physician attendance at community health fairs
  • Create and disseminate quarterly departmental alumni newsletter
  • Maintain and distribute Attending Physicians license and malpractice insurance status
  • Facilitate hiring and onboarding of new faculty
  • Schedule meetings for Chair and faculty
  • Support and represent the Chair at meetings in her absence
  • Assist with maintenance of departmental PR initiatives and social media platforms
  • Facilitate the efficient, ethical, and regulatory‑compliant conduct of research in the department of dermatology:
  • Ensure study is compliance with local and federal laws and regulations
  • Create and/or maintain all documents and records related to the study
  • Act as a liaison between the PI and study sponsor
  • Prepare for site visits, regulatory visits, and audits
  • Maintain accurate records, including regulatory binders
  • Conduct patient recruitment and follow‑up for research studies
  • Data gathering and entry for research studies
  • Prepare and submit IRB applications
  • Collect and store study samples
  • Manage study budgets and purchasing
  • Assist with organizing research / educational conferences
  • Attend and present at dermatology and/or research conferences
  • Complete required training in research methods and regulatory compliance
  • Recruit and screen potential study participants and perform intake assessments
  • Act as a point of reference for study participants by answering questions and keeping them informed of the study progress
  • Manage the inventory of equipment and supplies related to the study and order more as needed
  • Attend meetings, events and seminars to promote studies
  • Collect specimens and input data and patient information into electronic systems
  • Create reports on each study, including notes on protocols, workload, data collection, and other reports as needed

Core Competencies

  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high level of confidentiality
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Superior organizational and time management skills
  • Capable of working independently with minimal supervision
  • Capable of working as part of a team
  • Skilled with standard computer programs including the MS Office Suite
  • Research experience, including use of RedCap and statistical software preferred, but not required.
  • Ability to speak a second language is an asset, but not required
  • Understanding of medical terminology as well as standard clinical procedures and protocols
  • Clinical experience preferred but not required
  • Advanced knowledge of office and administrative practices and principles.
  • Ability to operate a fax, copier, scanner, telephone, computer.
  • Skill in typing and the operation of computers, related software applications (e.g., Microsoft Suite, Zoom etc.).
  • Knowledge and skill in managing websites and professional social media content. Ability to problem solve and make decisions.
  • Ability to adapt to changes in office technology and software to ensure efficient office practices.
  • Ability to exercise discretion and ensure a high-level of confidentiality. Excellent verbal and written communication skills (a writing sample may be requested after the interview).
  • Strong organizational skills, flexibility, motivation, ability to multitask.
  • The ability to work independently, establish and maintain effective harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

Applicants must have at least a Bachelor’s degree preferably in STEM. Research and Admin exposure is desired but not required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Pay Range: $72,727 - $80,000

title: MECANICO DE AUTOS - ITAVEMA BYD RECREIO
description:
O Mecânico de Autos é responsável por executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos, assegurando qualidade, segurança, produtividade e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos. Atua em diagnósticos mecânicos, elétricos, eletrônicos, híbridos e, quando aplicável, em veículos elétricos a bateria. Deve interpretar manuais técnicos, seguir normas de segurança e ambientais, e utilizar corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos homologados, contribuindo diretamente para a satisfação do cliente e o desempenho do pós‑vendas da concessionária.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos BYD conforme ordem de serviço.
  • Efetuar troca de óleo e filtros (óleo do motor, ar do motor, ar-condicionado, combustível).
  • Executar alinhamento e balanceamento de rodas com equipamentos adequados.
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas e eletrônicas utilizando scanner automotivo homologado pela montadora.
  • Executar serviços mecânicos nos sistemas:
    • Suspensão: substituição de amortecedores, bandejas, buchas, molas, pivôs e bieletas.
    • Freios: troca de pastilhas, discos, lonas, tambores, cilindros, sangria do sistema e verificação do fluido.
    • Direção: manutenção de caixas de direção mecânica ou elétrica, terminais e barras de direção.
    • Arrefecimento: troca de bomba d’água, reservatório, válvula termostática, mangueiras e verificação de vazamentos.
    • Transmissão: substituição de homocinéticas, semieixos, retentores e verificação de fluido do câmbio.
  • Interpretar manuais técnicos e diagramas elétricos.
  • Cumprir os procedimentos de segurança e ambientais estabelecidos pela montadora.
  • Preencher corretamente OSs, apontando serviços realizados, peças trocadas e tempo aplicado.
  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos BYD e manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias.
  • Utilizar corretamente os equipamentos, ferramentas especiais e EPI’s.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo.
  • Desejável: Curso Técnico em Mecânica Automotiva, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas (SENAI ou equivalente).
  • Tempo: Mínimo de 2 anos em oficina mecânica ou concessionária automotiva.
  • Segmento: Veículos leves.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com veículos híbridos e elétricos, e vivência em processos padronizados de concessionárias.

Benefícios

title: Engenheiro de Automação Especialista
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visam diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Como Engenheiro de Automação Especialista, sua missão será fornecer suporte técnico e resolver problemas em sistemas de controle e automação e, apoio as disciplinas e Instrumentação e Telecomunicações em toda frota PRIO, além de monitorar e auditar manutenções em controladores, servidores, instrumentos e sensores. Além disso, você também deverá garantir a integridade dos ativos de automação, assegurando a conformidade com as melhores práticas de gestão e atualizações de hardware e software. Além disso, você será responsável por realizar estudos conceituais para modificações, conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA) para falhas, supervisionar comissionamento e start-up de sistemas críticos, e revisar propostas técnicas para aquisição de novos sistemas e componentes.

#LI-DS1

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir a integridade e aplicação das melhores práticas para gestão dos ativos de automação (hardware e software), atendendo aos requisitos de vida útil, obsolescência e atualizações;
  • Realizar estudos conceituais para modificações em sistemas de controle, automação, instrumentação e telecomunicações das unidades operadas;
  • Revisar tecnicamente propostas para aquisição de sistemas e componentes;
  • Supervisionar comissionamento e start-up de sistemas críticos;
  • Realizar estudos de RCA (root-cause analysis) para eventos de falhas de equipamentos e sistemas de automação, instrumentação e telecomunicações.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Controle e Automação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em análise de lógica, operação, manutenção e troubleshooting de sistemas de controle (PLCs Siemens, ABB e Rockwell);
  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas de supervisão (Siemens, ABB e Rockwell);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em redes industriais e seus principais protocolos de comunicação (Profibus, Modbus, Ethernet-IP, OPC, entre outras);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em instrumentação industrial (troubleshooting, calibração e especificação);
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em controles PID e sintonia de malhas;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em sistemas de detecção de fogo e gás.

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Content Services Liaison Manager
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Department

Partnerships & Media

Location

Brazil

The Position

The Content Services Liaison Manager will report jointly to the Zurich-based FWWC Content Services Project Lead. The successful candidate will be responsible for the planning and coordination of all event-related video content production, as well as ensuring the successful delivery of pre‑event and in‑tournament video content to FIFA stakeholders. The Content Services Liaison Manager will be the in‑country point of contact for all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives or stadium authorities and FIFA’s Media Partners in relation to non‑live content services. The successful individual will work closely with the FIFA Content Services team at FIFA HQ, Zurich to develop content strategies for the event, as well as communicating the confirmed content plans (long‑form, short‑form, social, audio) to all relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include 1 year to go, the Final Draw, two Play‑off Tournaments, 100 days to go and the main tournament period (June–July 2027). The position will require periods of extended travel and long operational hours. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and oversee all pre‑event content production based on the overall tournament content‑plan developed in close collaboration with the FIFA Content Services Team in Zurich.
  • Ensure all content creation and delivery for the tournament is communicated clearly and promoted to all stakeholders.
  • Liaise with the FIFA team in Zurich around the creation and distribution of all future content. Report all developments to the Head of Production and work closely with all areas of the FIFA content team.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts to ensure they are informed about and engaged with all filming projects and that their individual content requirements are taken care of.
  • Potentially liaise with the North‑and South American Medial Partners (MP) to coordinate the delivery of produced content, discuss long and short‑form programming opportunities and social media packages and assets – to be done in conjunction with FIFA Zurich.
  • Investigate new North and South American based opportunities around potential long and short‑form programming, branded content, social media and audio projects, including podcasts.
  • Lead weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for FWWC content services related topics within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and FIFA Content Services Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to support the FIFA Content Services Project Lead based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office.
  • Work closely with the local Host Broadcast and Media Partnerships department as their main point of contact for any FIFA Content Services related topics.
  • Pre‑planning, onsite support and supervision of the content production for the Play‑off Final tournaments, the Final Draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

Your Profile

  • A strong background in editorial sports television production or sports television production management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a producer or production manager in a comparable content production related role within a fast‑paced environment involving complex projects – ideally at a similar international sports event.
  • A knowledge of and participation in the South American Sports TV industry.
  • Contacts within the national football associations in South America.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high‑pressed situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high‑quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organization.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
  • Highly organized and proven to be cool‑headed under pressure.
  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at


About the Team


The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function.


About the Role


As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment.


You’ll Be Responsible For



  • Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management.

  • Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations.

  • Owning the end‑to‑end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems.

  • Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations.

  • Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first‑contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders.

  • Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows.

  • Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential for a regulated financial environment.

  • Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale.


Mandatory qualifications



  • 7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline.

  • Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred.

  • Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function.

  • Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end‑to‑end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it.

  • Ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced, engineering‑led environment, with strong influence‑without‑authority skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership.


Nice‑to‑have qualifications



  • Experience in fintech, high‑growth tech, or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles.

  • Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams.


What We Offer



  • Greenfield, high‑visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero.

  • Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering.

  • A culture that values ownership and getting foundations right, without bureaucracy for its own sake.

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank.

  • Medical Plan.

  • NuLanguage – Language Course Program.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Sênior
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores

  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Integridade Sênior (Inspeção) que será responsável pela gestão da integridade e inspeção de dutos e equipamentos, incluindo identificação, mensuração e proposição de mitigação, garantindo a segurança operacional, a confiabilidade do sistema de transporte e o atendimento às regulamentações vigentes, com foco em Proteção Catódica e desejável conhecimento em NR‑13/SPIE.

Responsabilidades

  • Proteção Catódica: gerenciar e acompanhar sistemas de proteção catódica de dutos, incluindo monitoramento de potenciais, desempenho de retificadores, interferências eletromagnéticas e condições de corrosão externa. Analisar resultados de levantamentos de campo (CIPS, DCVG, PCM/A-Frame, entre outros) e propor ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Inspeção e Integridade: Planejar, acompanhar e aprovar atividades de inspeção e integridade de dutos e equipamentos, com foco em mecanismos de corrosão interna e externa. Avaliar ameaças à integridade (corrosão, interferências, SCC, danos mecânicos, defeitos de fabricação e soldagem).
  • Avaliação de Defeitos: Realizar análises de defeitos com base em normas técnicas (API 579, ASME B31.G, B31.8, entre outras).
  • Gestão de Indicadores: Atualizar e acompanhar KPIs da área, elaborando relatórios técnicos e de suporte ao gestor.
  • Gestão do Conhecimento: Orientar técnicos, promover boas práticas de inspeção e fortalecer a cultura de integridade.
  • Gestão de Contratos: Selecionar, contratar e acompanhar serviços de inspeção e integridade em campo.

Requisitos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia.
  • Experiência em proteção catódica, integridade de dutos e desejável NR‑13.
  • Domínio: Proteção Catódica, Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento: NR‑13, SPIE, Avaliação de defeitos (API 579/ASME B31.G), ASME B31.8/B31.8S, PIGs, SCC, soldagem e reparos, ArcGIS/Google Earth, gestão de riscos e contratos.
  • Inglês intermediário (mínimo).

Diferencial

  • Atuação ou disponibilidade para atuar como PLH.
  • Certificações em inspeção/END/soldagem.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Participação em eventos e fóruns técnicos.

Oferecemos

  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolvimento e aprendizado contínuo.
  • Bolsa-auxílio e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado: Cartão flexível Alimentação/Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco Nacional e Odontológico Privian Master, Seguro de vida, Previdência Privada, Total Pass, Auxílio-medicamentos pelo Vidalink, Vale-presente, Vale-transporte, Ticket de Natal, Auxílio creche/babá e PLR.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com o Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.

Venha transportar o futuro conosco!

Descrição da vaga

O Mecânico de Autos é responsável por executar serviços de manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos, assegurando qualidade, segurança, produtividade e cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos. Atua em diagnósticos mecânicos, elétricos, eletrônicos, híbridos e, quando aplicável, em veículos elétricos a bateria. Deve interpretar manuais técnicos, seguir normas de segurança e ambientais, e utilizar corretamente ferramentas e equipamentos homologados, contribuindo diretamente para a satisfação do cliente e o desempenho do pós-vendas da concessionária.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em veículos BYD conforme ordem de serviço.
  • Efetuar troca de óleo e filtros (óleo do motor, ar do motor, ar-condicionado, combustível).
  • Executar alinhamento e balanceamento de rodas com equipamentos adequados.
  • Diagnosticar falhas mecânicas e eletrônicas utilizando scanner automotivo homologado pela montadora.
  • Executar serviços mecânicos nos sistemas:
  • Suspensão: substituição de amortecedores, bandejas, buchas, molas, pivôs e bieletas.
  • Freios: troca de pastilhas, discos, lonas, tambores, cilindros, sangria do sistema e verificação do fluido.
  • Direção: manutenção de caixas de direção mecânica ou elétrica, terminais e barras de direção.
  • Arrefecimento: troca de bomba d’água, reservatório, válvula termostática, mangueiras e verificação de vazamentos.
  • Transmissão: substituição de homocinéticas, semieixos, retentores e verificação de fluido do câmbio.
  • Interpretar manuais técnicos e diagramas elétricos.
  • Cumprir os procedimentos de segurança e ambientais estabelecidos pela montadora.
  • Preencher corretamente OSs, apontando serviços realizados, peças trocadas e tempo aplicado.
  • Participar de treinamentos técnicos BYD e manter-se atualizado sobre novas tecnologias.
  • Utilizar corretamente os equipamentos, ferramentas especiais e EPI’s.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • ✔️ - Ensino Médio Completo.
  • ✔️ - Desejável: Curso Técnico em Mecânica Automotiva, Eletromecânica ou áreas correlatas (SENAI ou equivalente).

BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay‑for‑performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.

BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

Awards

For over 230 years, the people of BNY Mellon have been at the forefront of finance, expanding the financial markets while supporting investors throughout the investment lifecycle.   • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

We are recruiting an Associate General Counsel for Faculty Affairs and Employment or a Senior Associate General Counsel, Faculty Affairs, Employment & Labor Relations. The selected incumbent provides in-house legal counsel and strategic collaboration with Howard University and Howard University Hospital executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals regarding a comprehensive range of employment and labor relations matters. Advises and represents the University and Hospital on employment matters including but not limited to wrongful termination, discrimination, workers' compensation and wage and hour claims brought by University and Hospital employees, including providing advice and counseling to University executives, academic administrators and Office of Human Resources professionals to ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as well as advising on such matters in litigation.

Provides counsel and legal sufficiency review of legal documents, settlement agreements, discipline, suspensions, terminations, workplace policies, handbooks and other documents concerning employees. Supervises and manages outside counsel in employment and labor relations matters.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have substantial labor experience, in addition to a strong foundation in an employment related practice. The Senior Associate General Counsel will provide in-house legal counsel services and represents Howard University as the supervisor of the primary in-house labor attorney handling all matters involving the bargaining units of the University and Hospital and related collective bargaining agreements.

Supervisory Accountability

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will not have any direct supervisory accountability, but is expected to be primarily responsible for all employment and faculty related matters with a high level of autonomy.

The Senior Associate General Counsel will supervise all employment-related and labor-related work of other staff attorneys. Serves as supervisor of other in-house counsel who will be first chair on labor, collective bargaining and union matters.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include administrators, faculty, and staff of the University. External contacts include federal and local courts and administrative agencies including EEOC, OHR, DOL and OWH.

Principal Accountabilities

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have primary responsibilities to provide in-house legal advice, interpretation, and representation in a broad range of legal issues with employment related matters with knowledge of the labor process. In addition, a candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel position will have supervisory responsibility for labor matters, including but not limited to representation in government agency investigations, grievances, arbitrations, and in cases before the National Labor Relations Board.

Responsibilities include reviewing and drafting workplace handbooks, policies and guidelines for legal sufficiency; providing review and recommendations regarding various regulatory and compliance matters.

Other responsibilities include conducting formal training on EEO, wage & hour, mandated leave benefits, union representation, whistleblower, and other pertinent employment and labor law topics for new hires, current employees, and leadership.

The incumbent also prepares legal documents such as offer letters, academic appointment contracts, settlement agreements, termination agreements, collective-bargaining agreements, employment agreements. Also responsible for overseeing preparation of responses to information requests directed at Howard University or Hospital, advisory memoranda and documents relating to collective bargaining agreements, litigation matters or agency proceedings.

Represents the University in legal and quasi-legal proceedings, including the District of Columbia and Federal courts and before government agencies on employment and labor relations matters and on other legal matters. Represents the University in hearings, meetings and in other forums related to University legal matters, as needed.

Drafts and negotiates commitments involving University resources; principally contracts, settlements, other agreements and statements of University policy for subsequent approval by the General Counsel and University Officers.

Reviews documents for other University offices for legal implications and possible legal policy questions.

Responds to University officials' request for advice in areas of assigned responsibility.

Serves as office resource on updates and developments in employment and labor law.

Provides legal expertise and otherwise represents the office in meetings with University officials and individuals outside of the University.

Provides counseling, advice, and guidance to academic administrators, supervisors and other management officials on faculty and staff conduct and performance problems.

Provides assistance with conflict resolution, as requested. Furnishes recommendations to academic administrators, department heads, managers, and supervisors concerning possible courses of action in handling employee problems and concerns. Reviews employee discipline and discharge matters and makes recommendation for appropriate course of action.

Reviews statistics and surveys and prepares analyses for review by the General Counsel. Reviews periodic utilization reports and develops appropriate management responses. Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

Detailed knowledge of federal and local laws applicable to employment and labor relations, and judicial and administrative agency systems and procedures.

Ability to conduct and manage adversarial proceedings on behalf of the University and Hospital before courts and administrative agencies.

Ability to plan, direct and conduct independent legal research and related analyses on a variety of labor and employment law topics.

Ability to participate effectively in fact-finding investigations, present findings and develop related recommendations.

Ability to articulate the University's position, listen and negotiate effectively.

Superior verbal and written communication skills.

Ability to draft, review, revise and edit documents in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Ability to identify possible need for action and to plan, supervise, and execute appropriate assignments with minimal guidance or supervision.

Ability to work productively under pressure, to adhere to and enforce deadlines, and to project need for and effectuate team efforts required to meet deadlines.

Ability to follow guidance and direction and to provide effective guidance and direction.

Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, students, University officials, union representatives and the general public.

Minimum Requirements

A candidate for the Associate General Counsel position will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and six years of post J.D. legal experience which includes at least four years of substantial employment experience, with additional knowledge of the labor process.

A candidate for the Senior Associate General Counsel will have a Juris Doctor from an accredited law school and eight years of substantial labor and employment experience.

All candidates must have a strong academic record; excellent oral and written communication skills. Membership or eligibility for membership in the District of Columbia Bar is required.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Salary Range

The anticipated salary for the Associate General Counsel position is $172,800.

The anticipated salary for the Senior Associate General Counsel position is $207,800.

Sobre a Cardway

A Cardway é uma empresa brasileira de meios de pagamento e soluções digitais, formada a partir da união entre o Grupocard e a Movilway, duas referências no mercado que somam décadas de expertise e inovação no setor.

Atuamos com um portfólio completo e integrado de soluções que reúne meios de pagamento, telecom, serviços digitais, mobilidade urbana, serviços bancários e a plataforma CardHub, conectando tudo em um único ecossistema para nossos parceiros.

Nosso foco é simplificar o dia a dia dos nossos parceiros e impulsionar o crescimento dos seus negócios em todo o Brasil.

Nossa cultura é guiada por valores que orientam nossas decisões:

  • Compromisso com Parceiros e Clientes
  • Transparência
  • Excelência na Prática

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem quando as pessoas se sentem parte e trabalham juntas em um ambiente ético, colaborativo e bem estruturado.

Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

Local de atuação: São Gonçalo/RJ

Para esta posição, buscamos pessoas com vontade de aprender, se desenvolver e construir relacionamentos de confiança com nossos parceiros.

  • Ensino médio completo

Diversidade importa (e muito!)

Esta vaga também é destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

Na Cardway, valorizamos atitudes, conhecimento e vontade de fazer acontecer. Acreditamos no poder das conexões e na diversidade em todas as suas formas.

Independentemente de idade, raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual, buscamos pessoas com brilho nos olhos e vontade de transformar.

A Cardway não realiza qualquer tipo de cobrança, solicitação de curso pago ou taxa em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo. Todas as comunicações oficiais são feitas exclusivamente por canais da empresa.

title: Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager
description:
Department

Broadcast & Media Operations

Location

Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
  • Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • ACCOUNTABILITY : We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • LEADERSHIP : We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines.
  • INITIATIVE : We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING : We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
  • INNOVATION : We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION : We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization's global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality.
  • INCLUSIVITY : We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portugues. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires frequent travel to participate in meetings and venue tours.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: ANALISTA DE PROCESSOS E PROJETOS PLENO - CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE (INCLUSIVA PARA PCD).
description:
A Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa.

Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

A área de Customer Experience da Leve Saúde atua de forma estratégica na melhoria contínua da jornada do beneficiário, conectando dados, operação e transformação.

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Processos e Projetos Pleno para atuar no time de Customer Experience (CX), sendo responsável por conduzir iniciativas de melhoria da jornada do cliente, com foco em gerar impacto real para o cliente e para o negócio.

Procuramos uma pessoa com perfil mão na massa, organizado e protagonista , que tenha autonomia para conduzir projetos, navegar entre áreas e transformar problemas em soluções práticas.

A Leve é uma empresa em crescimento acelerado, por isso, mais do que seguir um escopo rígido, esperamos alguém disposto a construir, adaptar e evoluir junto com a área , com potencial para assumir desafios cada vez mais complexos ao longo do tempo.

O que nos move:

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso:

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Conduzir projetos estruturantes de melhoria da jornada do cliente, do diagnóstico à implementação;
  • Gerenciar iniciativas utilizando metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban e etc),incluindo gestão de backlog e priorização a partir de metodologia;
  • Traduzir dados e insights da Voz do Cliente em planos de ação estruturados;
  • Apoiar na gestão de mudanças, reduzindo o impacto no cliente e garantindo a adoção das melhorias pelas áreas envolvidas;
  • Mapear e redesenhar processos e jornadas do cliente, identificando oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Conduzir workshops e rituais de projetos (brainstorming, planning, sprint e reviews);
  • Articular com diferentes áreas (operação, rede, relacionamento, tecnologia, etc.) para garantir a execução e sucesso das entregas;
  • Elaborar materiais com storytelling claro e objetivo, evidenciando resultados;
  • Acompanhar indicadores e garantir a mensuração dos resultados das iniciativas implementadas;
  • Utilizar ferramentas, incluindo inteligência artificial, para otimizar análises, organização e execução das atividades.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Gestão de Projetos, Processos, Tecnologia, Comunicação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em gestão de projetos e melhoria de processos;
  • Vivência na gestão de squads, aplicação de metodologias ágeis e condução de projetos multidisciplinares;
  • Forte capacidade de planejamento, organização, gestão de riscos, acompanhamento de cronogramas e comunicação com stakeholders diversos;
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados e apoiar na geração de insights;
  • Conhecimento em mapeamento e redesenho de processos/jornadas;
  • Habilidade de construção de materiais executivos com storytelling;
  • Domínio de ferramentas como Pacote Google, Office, Jira, Bizagi e Miro.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Customer Experience ou Jornada do cliente;
  • Vivência em empresas de saúde ou operações complexas;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de experiência (NPS, CSAT, churn);
  • Experiência com gestão de mudanças estruturadas;
  • Familiaridade com uso de ferramentas de IA no dia a dia de trabalho;
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital, automação dE processos ou implantação de tecnologias.

title: Referee Operations Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Under the guidance of the FIFA Refereeing (Zurich) and Team Services (FIFA27), the Referee Operations Manager will lead the planning and delivery of all referee operations during FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ and related refereeing events. The role is to ensure the excellence of all services required for match officials, fully aligned with FIFA’s Refereeing Requirements, and to guarantee seamless coordination between FIFA Refereeing, Local Team Services and all relevant functional areas. The Referee Operations Manager will be based in the FIFA 27 headquarters in Rio de Janeiro during the planning stage and at the Referee Base Camp during tournament time.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure that all operational plans, services, logistics and procedures for Referee Services fully comply with FIFA Refereeing Requirements, delivering the highest standards of service quality to match officials.
  • Operationalise technical and operational needs from FIFA Refereeing into practical, efficient and integrated operational solutions.
  • Lead cross‑functional coordination with all relevant functional areas (FAs) to ensure full integration of Referee Services into tournament operations.
  • Represent Referee Services in operational meetings, workshops, and multi‑stakeholder sessions, ensuring alignment, follow‑up of action points, and consistent internal communication.
  • Coordinate closely with FIFA Refereeing, FIFA Team Services and FIFA27 Team Services for all operational and administrative matters.
  • Assist in preparing and refining Referee Services operational concepts, policies, procedures and service plans.
  • Drive operational readiness for all referee‑related events, including workshops, seminars, test events, inspection visit or any other preparatory activities.
  • Act as the dedicated Refereeing representative for stadium and training site operational planning, ensuring full integration of referee‑specific requirements.
  • Lead the planning and delivery of VAR referee operations at the International Broadcast Center, in coordination with Technology, Broadcast Operations and VAR leadership.
  • Organize the FIFA Referee Cup and Pre‑competition Seminar prior to the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™.
  • Work closely with Workforce, Volunteers and HR on planning, recruiting, onboarding and training temporary staff and volunteers dedicated to Referee Services.
  • Identify, secure and coordinate local football teams to participate in daily practical training sessions with referees.
  • Prepare and deliver training materials, operational manuals and readiness exercises for Referee Services staff and volunteers.
  • Monitor the Referee Services budget in close coordination with Team Services, ensuring efficient and responsible use of resources.
  • Lead the overall project planning for Referee Services, managing timelines, milestones and deliverables across all team members.
  • Based at the Referee Base Camp, the Referee Operations Manager will transition to a Referee Liaison Officer (RLO) role and will be responsible for:
  • Reporting to and assisting FIFA Refereeing, as required, with all local arrangements (matches, training sessions, meetings, spectating referees, etc).
  • Cooperating with all FAs and service providers to support referees and FIFA Refereeing daily.
  • Coordinating the local players requested for the practical training sessions with the referees.
  • Exchanging information, in particular any last‑minute changes to the daily program, with training site authorities and all FAs involved in the referees’ daily operations.
  • Organizing social activities for the FIFA Refereeing delegation team during the competition, as required.
  • Supervising and coordinating the Referee Services support staff, including the Venue Referee Liaison Officers and volunteers at each stadium.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Excellent communicator with strong planning, organizational and administrative skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to consistently deliver at a high standard.
  • Able to work closely and collaboratively with others, while being self‑motivated and able to work independently.
  • Able to manage a group of people working on the same projects and, as required, coordinate people in other functional areas to contribute to projects.
  • Capable of making decisions using problem‑solving skills and exercising sound judgment to achieve results.
  • Be very dynamic, stress‑resistant, motivated, excellent interpersonal and problem‑solving skills.
  • Comfortable working in an international, demanding and changing environment.
  • Able to adapt to and work well with people of other cultures and backgrounds.
  • Able to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain experienced and less experienced employees.
  • High energy levels, exceptional planning and organizational skills, strong negotiation and facilitation skills, excellent communication and presentation skills and positive relationship management abilities.
  • The right to work in Brazil.
  • Portuguese and English are mandatory, and Spanish is a great plus.
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Esse profissional será responsável por acompanhar o ciclo de vida dos produtos, identificar oportunidades de melhoria e inovação e garantir que as decisões estejam alinhadas às metas comerciais e à proposta de valor da empresa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoio à liderança: contribuir com análises estratégicas e apresentações executivas para suportar decisões de negócio e roadmap de produtos.

Somos a Monte Carlo Joias. Onde tudo pode ser extraordinário. Uma rede de joalherias que torna momentos inesquecíveis com luxo e design. Desenvolvemos e mantemos os talentos que buscam desafios reais e que querem crescer e apresentar seus resultados com foco no Nosso Cliente . title: Partner Rights Delivery Manager
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Partnerships & Media

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Working alongside the FIFA/FIFA27 Partnership Rights Delivery (PRD) team in Zurich and Brazil and reporting to the FIFA Senior Partner Rights Delivery Manager in Zurich and the FIFA27 Head of Commercial Partnerships, the Partner Rights Delivery Manager supports the operational implementation and fulfillment of FIFA Commercial Partners’ contractual rights and obligations. This role includes coordination of official sites requirements, stadiums preparations, and the delivery of Commercial Partners activities and related deliverables. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful tournament through the delivery of FIFA’s commercial operations in the host country.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the planning and execution of the operational implementation and delivery of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Commercial Partners agreements.
  • Implement and coordinate all commercial operations in line with the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition‑related events and sites.
  • Support the implementation of all commercial/sponsorship activations and commercial rights programmes of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Collaborate with the Stadium Venue Managers, Stadium Authorities, and relevant Functional Areas to ensure delivery of the contractual rights and obligations of FIFA’s Commercial Partners.
  • Assist in coordinating and delivering stadium inspections, open days, and Commercial Partner operational visits, ensuring alignment with commercial and F&B concessions requirements.
  • Manage and monitor the implementation of FIFA’s clean site obligation and Commercial Partners’ exclusivity in the official sites.
  • Ensure the Commercial Partners’ recognition programme is correctly implemented in designated stadium areas in accordance with established guidelines, including within the F&B concessions programme.
  • Assist in the implementation of specific commercial/marketing projects at the stadiums, such as Stadium Fan Experience areas, Special Marketing Programmes, Youth Programme, Value‑in‑Kind (VIK) operations, LED pitch side board operations, and other Commercial Partner activities, in coordination with the FIFA/FIFA27 project leads and the entire Partnership Rights Delivery team.
  • Act as an operational point of contact for Commercial Partners in the host country for commercial delivery matters, supporting issue resolution and expectation management throughout the event delivery process.
  • Work with PRD suppliers and assist them in the delivery of their obligations.
  • Support the planning and delivery of all Partnership Rights Delivery related spaces, facilities and flows in the stadiums (and other official sites) as per defined stadium requirements under the guidance of the FIFA PRD project lead.
  • Provide operational support to the Partnership Rights Delivery Venue Team (Marketing Venue Managers) during the tournament period.
  • Take primary responsibility for the administrative preparation and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive documentation, operational guidelines, briefing materials, tracking tools, and structured reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency across all Partnership Rights Delivery activities.
  • Prepare comprehensive reports, guidelines, and presentations on rights delivery progress, highlighting key achievements, risks, and recommendations.
  • Contribute to the preparation of tournament debrief documentation.
  • Assume administrative responsibility for the Partnership Rights Delivery team and provide support as required.

Your Profile

Education

  • University degree, ideally in Sports Management, Sports Administration, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field, with exposure to commercial/marketing operations or sponsorship activations.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a comparable role within an international, fast‑paced, and project‑driven environment, preferably in the events and/or sports industry.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial operations and/or sponsorship activations in major event settings and/or the sports industry.
  • Experience working in international sports events or large‑scale event environments is considered a strong advantage.

title: Workday System Analyst
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

Focusing in Enrollment Management, Financial Aid, and Student Financials (Undergraduate Admissions, Curriculum & Advising, Records/Registration, Financial Aid, and Student Financials), the purpose of this role is to ensure Workday Student operations are efficient and effective while aligning with the organization’s business objectives. This position serves as a critical liaison with other Business Units and IT in translating business needs into solutions to support a seamless user experience.

Supervisory Authority

This role does not have direct supervisory responsibilities but requires the ability to collaborate across different teams. The incumbent may occasionally provide guidance to other analysts or team members as necessary.

Nature And Scope

Operating within a dynamic and fast-paced environment, this role contributes to the organization’s operational efficiency by supporting Workday Student Information System configurations and resolving functional area-related challenges. The incumbent will engage with stakeholders to ensure that functional areas requirements are met while supporting functional area operations. The position demands a high level of analytical thinking, technical expertise, and strong communication skills and collaboration within the organization.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the Student Information Systems partner supporting designated Student areas in Workday, such as Admissions, Academic Foundations, Curriculum, Records/Registration, Advising, and Financial Aid.
  • Provide consultation to and collaborate with operational Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in student areas, the operational staff and management.
  • Collaborate with other functional areas and technical teams to build domain knowledge and technical requirements, providing solutions and impact analysis on design decisions.
  • Serve as technical subject matter expert on current and upcoming Workday capabilities with a creative approach to solutions.
  • Stay updated on new features and technical specifications within the application’s future roadmap and support feature adoption.
  • Support business units in evaluation and testing during releases and updating functionality in order to identify opportunities to improve and optimize the use of Workday.
  • Analyze and translate functional specifications and change requests into technical specifications to design functionality based on functional and technical requirements.
  • Design, change, configure and implement functionality to meet business unit requirements, including configuring Business Processes, supporting inbound and outbound integrations (monitor performance, issues and changes), and assisting with security and access while ensuring configuration is designed to meet functional and technical requirements.
  • Design and develop custom reports and calculated fields, including support to maintain/build EIBs, Core Connectors, and Studio integrations while ensuring interfaces are scalable, secure, and compliant with data governance policies.
  • Support business units in testing, such as with configuration, integrations, security, and releases.
  • Assist business units in maintaining master data values in Workday as pertains to the Student Information System functionality.
  • Provide support for existing functionality through incident management and serve as an escalation resource for technical assistance with issues that are received from users, support system requests and incident resolution, perform root‑cause analysis and implement corrective actions, and document resolutions and maintain knowledge‑base articles.
  • Support business units in analyzing impacts to configuration based on new releases or updates to system functionality, suggest or recommend and apply changes.
  • Liaise with HRIS, Payroll, Finance, Student, and IT teams to support cross‑functional initiatives working closely with operational subject matter experts, analysts, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.
  • Provide input and knowledge sharing with Workday technical and business unit team members and clients, as appropriate; providing technical guidance and training to stakeholders, as needed.
  • Participate in scheduled and ad hoc training in order to improve policy and process acumen.
  • Understand and follow Governance protocol and ensure attention to security and data privacy standards, including data quality, accuracy and integrity through analysis, clear documentation, and problem resolution.
  • Understand and follow defined development standards and best practices.

Core Competencies

  • Understanding of Student Specific operations and experience in student data management and reporting.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with students, cross-functional colleagues, and Enterprise Technology Services.
  • Ability to document and possess exceptional writing skills and a creative outlook with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to accurately collect information in order to understand and assess requirements and the situation.
  • Ability to identify improvement opportunities, understand business requirements and user needs, and then translate them into technical requirements.
  • Possess a creative approach to functionality and solutions.
  • Ability to prioritize workload and execute tasks independently, providing timely follow‑up and resolution.
  • Ability to work independently and provide high‑quality solutions.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced environment and handle both planned and unplanned responsibilities and multiple projects while meeting deadlines.
  • Proven ability to perform with a high degree of accuracy and with highly confidential data and strong attention to detail.
  • Solid understanding and working knowledge of Workday Student information system features and controls and experience in configuration and testing.
  • Ability to work in a team‑oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Strong problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of training and work experience.
  • 5+ years of Workday Student experience and training.
  • Student experience specific to the functional and system experience.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $110,000 - $125,000

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long‑term, asset‑backed business model that delivers high‑availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower‑carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose

  • As Operations Regulatory Engineer you ensure that Offshore Asset operations within your assigned scope continuously comply with applicable international and local regulations (also as assigned), with all related permits, licenses, certificates, and other authorizations, maintained valid at all times.

Responsibilities

  • You maintain an effective interface with all Regulatory Body and Recognized Organization representatives (e.g., Surveyors, Auditors) relevant to your assigned scope.
  • You remain informed of applicable regulations and related requirements and communicate them as required.
  • You provide support to the related Operations Management team(s) in understanding regulatory requirements applicable to their scope and in taking appropriate actions to sustainably meet those.
  • Jointly with the Operations Management teams, you plan and manage activities required to maintain regulatory permits, licenses, certificates (including notably Class) and other authorizations, valid at all times.
  • You maintain regulatory registers and records up‑to‑date.
  • You monitor the continued compliance with and validity of certificates and other authorizations.
  • You attend regulatory surveys and audits relevant to your assigned scope.
  • You lead or contribute to investigations of regulatory incidents if/as assigned.
  • You ensure completion of corrective actions related to your assigned scope.
  • You provide accurate reports for internal and external communication.
  • You communicate effectively and collaborate with all Stakeholders to ensure effective results.
  • You escalates critical issues to Management if required.

Education

  • Engineering or university degree in a relevant field e.g. Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Environmental Science, Law, Quality.
  • Professional certification in regulatory compliance or QHSE management (e.g., NEBOSH, IOSH).
  • Qualified Auditor/Surveyor.

Experience

  • Experience in a relevant industry sector, e.g. Maritime, Certification, Oil & Gas (ideally including FPSO operations), Petrochemicals.

Functional Competencies

  • Monitoring performance and compliance
  • Regulatory, law trends and developments
  • Regulatory Management
  • Inspection, testing, commissioning and monitoring
  • SBM Product Knowledge
  • Internal Audit Delivery
  • Management systems standards and framework
  • Environmental Management
  • Hazard Identification and Risk Management

General Information

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”).
